parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, curved cover made of durable plastic, designed to close the toilet bowl.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl, reduce odor emission, and provide a surface to sit on when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back and can rotate upward or downward to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the toilet is the main ceramic structure that supports the seat and contains the bowl and water tank.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, houses the flushing mechanism, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the water and waste lines.
